# Tickets Panel — Import-Generated `## Subtasks` Block Leaks Into the Ticket Body

## Goal

Stop the import-generated `## Subtasks` checklist — and its `<!-- generated by import — content below this line is not pushed to the remote ticket -->` marker — from rendering inside the ticket description in the Tickets panel. The panel already renders a live Subtasks nav above the description, so the block is duplicated, unreadable content in the one place a user reads the ticket.

What the user sees today, appended below the real description:

```
Subtasks

<!-- generated by import — content below this line is not pushed to the remote ticket -->
[ ] Daily Diary - Insight Report (86d3y20yy) — backlog
[ ] Daily Diary - Analytics (86d3y20nc) — backlog
```

### Problem analysis

Three facts combine, and no single one of them is the bug on its own.

**1. Something now writes that block on every ticket open.** `tickets.js:5229-5241` posts `importTicketSubtasks` the first time each ticket is selected in a session ("progressive subtask import"). `TicketsPanelProvider.ts:2395-2428` handles it by invoking `switchboard.importTaskAsDocument` with `includeSubtasks: true`, which appends `TaskViewerProvider._SUBTASKS_HEADER` (`TaskViewerProvider.ts:21956-21957`) plus one `- [ ] title (id) — status` line per subtask to the parent's local `.md`.

This is new behaviour introduced by the planning.js → tickets.js panel extraction. `planning.js:493` declares the same `_subtasksEnrichedFor` guard set but **never posts the message** — the variable is dead there. So in the pre-extraction panel this write never happened, and the block only ever appeared on an explicit "import with subtasks". That is why the user reports it as new.

**2. The detail pane renders the local file verbatim.** The local `.md` is the source of truth for the description (`tickets.js:7250-7251`, `localDescription: true`). Whatever is in the file body is rendered, and the import-generated block is in the file body.

**3. Three separate backend sites produce that display content, and they have drifted.** All three read the file, strip only the YAML frontmatter, and push the remainder as `content`:

| Site | Push | Strips the block? |
|---|---|---|
| `TicketsPanelProvider.ts:1798-1828` (`readLocalTicketFile`, strip at 1819) | `localTicketFileRead` | **yes** — a strip was added here on 2026-08-06 |
| `TicketsPanelProvider.ts:538-543` (file-watcher) | `ticketFileChanged` | **no** |
| `PlanningPanelProvider.ts:7006` (file-watcher) | `ticketFileChanged` | **no** |

### Root cause

The `## Subtasks` block is agent-facing context deliberately written into the ticket file, but there is **no single choke point that decides what the description pane is allowed to display**. Each producer re-implements "read file, drop frontmatter, send the rest", so a display rule added to one producer does not hold for the others.

A first fix (2026-08-06) added `TicketsPanelProvider._stripImportedSubtasksBlock` and applied it in `readLocalTicketFile` only. **It failed UAT**, and the ordering explains exactly why:

1. User clicks a ticket → `readLocalTicketFile` returns stripped content → the pane renders correctly, briefly.
2. The same click posts `importTicketSubtasks`, which **writes the file**.
3. The write fires the file watcher → `ticketFileChanged` pushes **unstripped** content (`TicketsPanelProvider.ts:543`).
4. `tickets.js:7285-7301` overwrites `renderedDescriptionHtml` with it, and the block appears.

The enrichment write is itself the trigger for the one push that was not fixed, so the strip is bypassed every time on the exact path that creates the problem.

**Secondary defect, same writer.** The enrichment write advances the file's mtime past `last_synced_at`, and `_ticketSyncStatusFromTimestamps` (`TicketsPanelProvider.ts:379-390`) reads that as `'modified'`. The handler itself guards against re-enriching an already-modified file (`TicketsPanelProvider.ts:2415-2416`), so the churn lands on the **first open of a clean file in a session** and then self-limits for subsequent opens — but the consequence sticks: `importAllTasks` (`TaskViewerProvider.ts:22585-22595`) checks mtime (not the handler guard), counts the file in `skippedModified`, and **declines to refresh it** ("skipped (locally modified — push or discard changes first)"). Merely opening a ticket once can therefore stop that ticket from ever refreshing again. This must be fixed alongside the display leak; it is the same unwanted write.

**Verb-path leak (found during improve review).** `importTicketSubtasks` is a **registered verb** — it appears in `TICKETS_VERBS` (`src/generated/verbAllowlist.ts:11`) and is dispatched by the verb engine / `LocalApiServer`. Removing the *webview* auto-post (step 3 below) closes only the in-editor trigger. An explicit caller — the standalone host, an external tool, the orchestrator — can still invoke the verb and trigger the enrichment write, churning mtime past `last_synced_at` without restamping it. The handler (`TicketsPanelProvider.ts:2419-2428`) writes the file and returns without refreshing `last_synced_at`. The codebase already has the exact restamp pattern: `TaskViewerProvider.ts:22643-22651` calls `cacheService.registerImportedTicket(...)` after every orphan-upsert write, with the comment *"Refresh last_synced_at, or this rewrite's mtime reads as a local edit."* The handler must do the same after a successful enrichment so the secondary defect is closed for **all** callers, not just the webview.

## User Review Required

Yes — two behaviour decisions need a human nod before coding:

1. **Removing the on-open auto-enrichment write.** Users who never explicitly imported subtasks will no longer get subtask context persisted into the parent's local `.md` automatically. The live Subtasks nav in the UI still shows subtasks, so nothing visible regresses — but agents/tools that read the local file for subtask context will only see it after an explicit "import with subtasks" (`handleTicketsImport(..., includeSubtasks: true)` at `tickets.js:3137/5164`). Confirm this is acceptable; it restores the pre-extraction panel behaviour.
2. **Restamping `last_synced_at` in the `importTicketSubtasks` verb handler.** After an explicit enrichment (webview or HTTP), the handler will refresh `last_synced_at` so the file does not read as falsely "modified." This means an explicit subtask enrichment no longer marks the parent as locally edited. Confirm this is the desired semantics for an explicit, user/tool-initiated enrichment (as opposed to a silent read side-effect, which is being removed).

## Complexity Audit (Routine vs Complex/Risky)

**Routine**
- Extracting the existing strip helper to a shared module and calling it from three producers.
- Adding a ratchet test that counts raw display-content producers.

**Complex / Risky**
- **Deciding what `rawContent` carries.** `rawContent` feeds the edit textarea and the push path (`tickets.js:7247`, `7292`). It must keep the block: `pushTicketEdits` truncates at `## Subtasks` to avoid sending it to the remote (guarded by `tickets-subtask-embedding.test.js:52`), and a save that dropped the block would silently delete the agent-facing context from the file. Only `content` may be stripped. Getting this backwards destroys data on the next local save.
- **The enrichment write itself.** Suppressing it entirely would remove locally-persisted subtask context that agents read from the ticket file. Gating it is a behaviour decision, not a mechanical fix — see Proposed Changes step 3 (remove the webview auto-trigger) and step 5 (restamp `last_synced_at` in the verb handler, which the original plan rejected but the improve review superseded — the rejection conflated the read-side-effect webview path with the explicit verb path).
- **`PlanningPanelProvider.ts:7006` is a live duplicate.** The Tickets tab still exists inside the Planning panel for older layouts. Fixing only the Tickets panel leaves the bug reachable there.

## Edge-Case & Dependency Audit

- **A user-authored `## Subtasks` heading.** The strip must key on the heading *immediately followed by the generated-by-import marker comment*, never on the heading alone. A ticket whose own description contains "## Subtasks" must render in full. The current regex (`/^##[ \t]+Subtasks[ \t]*\r?\n<!-- generated by import\b/m`) already requires the marker.
- **Legacy files written before the marker existed.** If any shipped version wrote the heading without the marker comment, those blocks will not be stripped. **Confirmed during improve review:** `_SUBTASKS_HEADING` (`TaskViewerProvider.ts:21955`, the marker-less constant `'\n\n## Subtasks\n'`) is referenced only at `22170` and `22623`, both `.indexOf()` lookups used to *find* an existing heading — it is **never used as a writer** (no `content += _SUBTASKS_HEADING` anywhere). So no shipped code produces a marker-less block, and the strip's marker-keyed regex is sufficient. If a future change ever writes with `_SUBTASKS_HEADING`, the strip needs a second, marker-less form gated on the block being trailing.
- **CRLF files.** The regex allows `\r?\n` between heading and marker; keep that.
- **Edit → save round-trip.** Open a ticket with a block, click edit, save without changes: the file must be byte-identical afterward. This is the assertion that proves `rawContent` was not stripped.
- **`_subtasksEnrichedFor` is per-session, not persistent.** Every panel reload re-enriches every ticket the user opens, so the mtime churn in the secondary defect recurs on each session.
- **`tickets-subtask-embedding.test.js`** pins that the header literal is defined exactly once and that the push-path truncation guard survives. Any refactor must keep both green.
- **No migration needed.** Files already carrying the block are unchanged by this work; only their rendering changes.

## Dependencies

- None. This is a self-contained bugfix against shipped code. No plan-to-plan ordering constraint; no feature prerequisite.

## Adversarial Synthesis

Key risks: (1) the `rawContent` vs `content` distinction is a data-loss axis — stripping `rawContent` would silently delete agent-facing subtask context on the next local save; (2) the secondary mtime-churn defect is only half-closed by removing the webview post, because `importTicketSubtasks` is a registered verb reachable via HTTP — the handler must restamp `last_synced_at` after enrichment or explicit callers still poison the refresh path; (3) the ratchet test pins a per-file count snapshot, not an abstract invariant, so its comment must instruct coders to bump `expected` when adding a stripped push. Mitigations: keep `rawContent` as the full body at all three producers (existing `pushTicketEdits` truncation guard + `tickets-subtask-embedding.test.js` pin the contract); restamp via `cacheService.registerImportedTicket(...)` following the `TaskViewerProvider.ts:22643-22651` pattern; document the ratchet-bump rule inline.

## Proposed Changes

### 1. `src/services/ticketDisplayContent.ts` (new) — one choke point

Move the strip out of `TicketsPanelProvider` into a module both providers import, so there is a single definition of "what the description pane may show".

```ts
/**
 * The `## Subtasks` block that importTicketSubtasks appends is context for agents
 * reading the local .md — never for the detail pane, which renders its own live
 * Subtasks nav above the description. Cut from the heading carrying the
 * generated-by-import marker to EOF.
 *
 * Keyed on heading + marker, never the heading alone: a ticket whose own
 * description contains "## Subtasks" must render in full.
 *
 * DISPLAY ONLY. `rawContent` (edit + push) must keep the block — pushTicketEdits
 * truncates at the heading so it never reaches the remote, and a save built from
 * stripped content would erase it from the file.
 */
export function stripImportedSubtasksBlock(content: string): string {
    const idx = content.search(/^##[ \t]+Subtasks[ \t]*\r?\n<!-- generated by import\b/m);
    return idx === -1 ? content : content.slice(0, idx).trimEnd();
}
```

### 2. Apply it at all three producers

- `src/services/TicketsPanelProvider.ts:1798-1828` (strip at 1819) — replace the private `_stripImportedSubtasksBlock` (defined at `121-124`) with the shared import (delete the private static).
- `src/services/TicketsPanelProvider.ts:538-543` — the watcher push. **This is the one that fails UAT today.**

```ts
const raw = nfs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
const content = raw.replace(/^---\n[\s\S]*?\n---\n?/, '').trim();
const displayContent = this._rewriteLocalImagePaths(
    stripImportedSubtasksBlock(content), path.dirname(filePath)
);
this.postMessageToWebview({ type: 'ticketFileChanged', provider, id, title, content: displayContent, rawContent: content });
```

- `src/services/PlanningPanelProvider.ts:7006` — same change, same reason.

In all three, `rawContent` stays the full body.

### 3. Stop the enrichment write from firing on every open

Recommended: keep the capability, remove the automatic trigger. Delete the `importTicketSubtasks` post at `tickets.js:5229-5241` and leave enrichment to the existing explicit import (`handleTicketsImport(..., includeSubtasks: true)` at `tickets.js:3137/5164`), which is what the pre-extraction panel did. The live Subtasks nav already shows subtasks in the UI without any file write, so nothing the user can see regresses.

> **Superseded:** "If the on-open write is kept instead, it MUST restamp `last_synced_at` after writing... Rejected as the primary option: it still rewrites files as a side effect of a read."
> **Reason:** The rejection conflated two callers. For the **webview on-open path**, restamping is indeed wrong — the write is a silent side effect of a read and should simply be removed (step 3 does that). But `importTicketSubtasks` is a **registered verb** (`TICKETS_VERBS`, `src/generated/verbAllowlist.ts:11`) reachable via the verb engine / `LocalApiServer` / standalone host. Removing the webview post does NOT unregister the verb, so an explicit HTTP caller can still trigger the enrichment write. For that explicit path the write IS the requested action (not a read side effect), and the handler currently returns without refreshing `last_synced_at` — leaving the file falsely "modified" and permanently excluded from refresh (`skippedModified`). The restamp is therefore mandatory for the verb path, not rejected.
> **Replaced with:** See step 5 — restamp `last_synced_at` in the `importTicketSubtasks` handler after a successful enrichment, so the secondary defect is closed for ALL callers (webview-removed + verb-restamped).

### 4. `src/test/tickets-subtask-embedding.test.js` — ratchet the producer count

Add a source-contract assertion so a fourth producer cannot silently reintroduce the leak:

```js
// Every site that pushes ticket body content for DISPLAY must route through the
// shared strip. Counting them is the ratchet: the 2026-08-06 fix patched one of
// three and shipped, because nothing pinned how many there were.
//
// The `expected` counts are a SNAPSHOT of the current producer set, not an
// abstract invariant. If you add a new display-content push that strips, BUMP
// `expected` for that file — do not delete your push to make the number fit,
// and do not rip out the ratchet. A push that does NOT strip is always a bug.
for (const [file, expected] of [['TicketsPanelProvider.ts', 2], ['PlanningPanelProvider.ts', 1]]) {
    const src = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '..', 'services', file), 'utf8');
    const pushes = (src.match(/type:\s*'(ticketFileChanged|localTicketFileRead)'/g) || []).length;
    const strips = (src.match(/stripImportedSubtasksBlock\(/g) || []).length;
    assert.strictEqual(strips, expected, `${file}: every display-content push must strip (bump expected if you added a stripped push)`);
    assert.ok(pushes <= expected, `${file}: a new display push needs a matching strip`);
}
```

### 5. `src/services/TicketsPanelProvider.ts:2419-2428` — restamp `last_synced_at` after explicit enrichment

The `importTicketSubtasks` verb handler writes the file via `switchboard.importTaskAsDocument` but returns without refreshing `last_synced_at`, so the file reads as falsely "modified." After a successful enrichment, restamp using the existing pattern from `TaskViewerProvider.ts:22643-22651`:

```ts
// After the successful executeCommand('switchboard.importTaskAsDocument', ...) at line 2423:
try {
    if (!this._cacheService) {
        this._cacheService = this._adapterFactories.getCacheService(workspaceRoot);
    }
    // Re-read the entry: importTaskAsDocument may have renamed the file if the
    // title changed. Resolve by id, not by the pre-write path.
    const refreshed = (await this._cacheService.getImportedTickets())
        .find((t: any) => t.slugPrefix === `${provider}_${id}`);
    if (refreshed) {
        await this._cacheService.registerImportedTicket(
            provider, id, refreshed.docName, refreshed.slugPrefix,
            refreshed.filePath, '', undefined, refreshed.url
        );
    }
} catch (regErr) {
    console.warn('[TicketsPanel] importTicketSubtasks: failed to restamp last_synced_at:', regErr);
}
return { success: true, enriched: true };
```

This closes the secondary defect for **all** callers of the verb — webview (if any explicit path still posts it) and HTTP/standalone. The webview *auto* post is removed in step 3; this step ensures the *capability* (retained by design) is safe to invoke.

## Verification Plan

**Automated**
1. `npm run compile-tests` — clean.
2. `npm run test:contract:tickets-subtasks` — existing assertions (single header literal, push-path truncation guard) stay green, plus the new producer ratchet.
3. New unit assertions on `stripImportedSubtasksBlock`: strips heading+marker+body to EOF; leaves a user-authored `## Subtasks` heading with no marker untouched; handles CRLF (assert the **stripped output**, not just that the call didn't throw); returns input unchanged when absent.
4. `npm run test:contract:verb-engine-tickets`, `npm run catalog:check`, `npm run push-routing:check` — no drift. Note: `importTicketSubtasks` stays in `TICKETS_VERBS` (the capability is retained), so the allowlist/catalog must not change.
5. New contract assertion: the `importTicketSubtasks` handler in `TicketsPanelProvider.ts` calls `registerImportedTicket` (the restamp) on the success path — grep the handler body for `registerImportedTicket` to prove the verb path refreshes `last_synced_at`.

**Manual UAT — this is the part the first fix skipped**
6. Build and install the VSIX (`src/` changes are not picked up by the running extension).
7. Open a ClickUp ticket that **has subtasks** and whose local file **already contains** the block. The description must show no `## Subtasks` heading, no marker comment, no `[ ]` lines. The Subtasks nav above the description still lists them.
8. Stay on that ticket for ~5 seconds without clicking away. The block must not reappear — this is the watcher/`ticketFileChanged` path that broke the first fix, and it fires shortly after the click (debounced 300ms; 5s is a safe margin).
9. Repeat for a Linear issue with sub-issues.
10. Open a ticket whose description legitimately contains the words "## Subtasks" with no marker — it must render in full.
11. Click edit, save with no changes, and confirm the file on disk is byte-identical (`git diff` on the tickets directory, or `md5` before/after). Proves `rawContent` was not stripped.
12. Open a ticket, then hit Refresh. It must not be reported as "skipped (locally modified)" — proves the on-open auto-write (step 3) is gone.
13. **Verb-path restamp (step 5):** Invoke `importTicketSubtasks` explicitly (via the verb engine / `LocalApiServer` HTTP, or an explicit "import with subtasks" UI action) on a clean ticket. After the enrichment completes, hit Refresh — the ticket must NOT be "skipped (locally modified)". Proves the handler restamps `last_synced_at` for explicit callers, closing the secondary defect on the HTTP/standalone path the webview-post removal does not cover.

## Recommendation

**Send to Coder.** Complexity 5 (Mixed: routine strip extraction across 3 producers + one well-scoped data-loss axis on the `rawContent`/`content` distinction + one behaviour decision with a verb-path restamp). The plan is single-scope, self-contained, and every claim has been verified against the source. The two behaviour decisions in **User Review Required** should be confirmed before dispatch.

## Completion Report

Implemented all five steps. Added `src/services/ticketDisplayContent.ts` as the single choke point and wired it into `TicketsPanelProvider.ts` (read and watcher) and `PlanningPanelProvider.ts` (watcher). Removed the on-open `importTicketSubtasks` post from `src/webview/tickets.js` and the now-dead `_subtasksEnrichedFor` session set. Added a `registerImportedTicket` restamp in the `importTicketSubtasks` verb handler so explicit callers do not mark the file locally modified. Added the producer-count ratchet to `src/test/tickets-subtask-embedding.test.js`. Compilation and tests were skipped per the task instructions.

## Review Findings

**Files changed (review):** `src/test/tickets-subtask-embedding.test.js` (ratchet regex fix + added unit tests for `stripImportedSubtasksBlock` + added restamp contract assertion).

**CRITICAL — ratchet test regex counted error responses as display pushes.** The `pushes` regex `type:\s*'(ticketFileChanged|localTicketFileRead)'` matched all 5 occurrences in `TicketsPanelProvider.ts` (including 3 `success:false` error responses with no `content:` field), but `expected` was 2 — so `pushes <= expected` (5 ≤ 2) was false and the test failed. Fixed by tightening the regex to `type:\s*'(ticketFileChanged|localTicketFileRead)'.*content:` so only content-bearing pushes are counted. Test now passes.

**MAJOR — missing unit tests for `stripImportedSubtasksBlock` (plan verification item 3).** The coder added the ratchet count but omitted the four behavioral assertions the plan required (strip-to-EOF, user-authored heading untouched, CRLF handling, no-block passthrough). Added all four by extracting and eval'ing the function from `ticketDisplayContent.ts` source.

**MAJOR — missing restamp contract assertion (plan verification item 5).** The plan required a contract assertion proving the `importTicketSubtasks` handler calls `registerImportedTicket`. Added assertion #16 that slices the handler body and greps for `registerImportedTicket`.

**Verification results:** `compile-tests` clean; `test:contract:tickets-subtasks` PASSED (all 16 assertions); `test:contract:verb-engine-tickets` 31/31 passed; `push-routing:check` passed; `verb-returns:check` passed (Tickets 56 ≤ 56). `catalog:check` reports drift, but this is from the unrelated `convertToSubtask` schema change in `verbSchemas.ts` (different plan in the same working tree) — this plan does not touch verbs or schemas. Gate-wiring audit: all named checks are wired in `.github/workflows/integration-tests.yml`. Remaining risk: manual UAT steps 6–13 were not executed (requires VSIX install); the `rawContent` vs `content` distinction is verified by code inspection and the existing push-truncation guard test, not by a round-trip save test.
